"''Right away!|The clone trooper and Padmé Amidala|}} A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] and fought in its first military conflict, the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], as part of the first batch of combat-ready clone troopers created on [[Kamino]]. He was part of the extraction team that arrived with [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] at the [[Petranaki Arena]] in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Rebublic gunships]] to save the surviving Jedi. During the ensuing battle, the clone traveled in a gunship with [[senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], but eventually fell from the ship along with Amidala due to the impact of shots fired by a [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter]]. ==Biography== [[File:AreYouAlrightClone-AOTC.png|thumb|left|180px|The clone trooper stands in the desert of Geonosis.]] This [[Cloning|clone]] was one of the many [[clone trooper]]s created on [[Kamino]] based on the [[DNA]] of [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] with the purpose of serving the [[Galactic Republic]] as a soldier. In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' he participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] during which he accompanied Yoda and numerous other clones to the Petranaki Arena to rescue the surviving Jedi of the skirmish. As the gunship the clone was aboard touched down to help create a perimeter around the depleted Jedi, they opened fire on the [[battle droid]]s along with his fellow troopers. The clone left the arena shortly afterward aboard the LAAT/i transport with Padmé Amidala, Anakin Skywalker, and Obi-Wan Kenobi. In the midst of battle, Skywalker and Kenobi noticed [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and ordered the gunship pilot to follow him. However, his complement of ''Nantex''-class starfighters attacked the transport and the clone trooper and Amidala fell off the ship in the ensuing firefight. After a short time, the trooper regained consciousness and hurried over to the senator to check one her, asking if she was alright. She confirmed this and the clone suggested that they should return to the [[Forward Command Center|forward command center]]. She refused, telling them to rally as many clones as possible and find a transport. The trooper complied and they flew to Dooku's hangar aboard another LAAT/i, backed up by other clones, just as the count was making his escape. The clone opened fire on the departing [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop]], but the [[Sith Lord]] managed to fled the planet. The clone trooper then secured the hangar as Amidala hurried over to the injured Skywalker and Kenobi. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Are you alright?''"
"''Uh-huh.''"
"''We better get back to the forward command center.|The clone trooper, and Senator Amidala|}} As a clone of [[Jango Fett]], the clone stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall. He was compassionate as he wanted to make sure Amidala had not been injured. He was also loyal, following orders without question. ==Equipment== This clone trooper wore standard [[phase I clone trooper armor]] and brandished a [[DC-15A blaster rifle]] ==Behind the scenes== This unnamed clone trooper first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. He was voiced by actor [[Temuera Morrison]] and portrayed using computer-generated imagery. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 26|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 26]] {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი კლონი სამხედრო 2 (ჯეონოსისი) }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
